variables: Menu/surface-rest at 0% opacity: the transparent end of the scroll fade on that surface. Points at the same primitive in each mode, so the fade blends without a tint.
Date/Calendar/surface at 0% opacity: the transparent end of the scroll fade on that surface. Points at the same primitive in each mode, so the fade blends without a tint.
TextInput/surface-rest at 0% opacity: the transparent end of the scroll fade on that surface. Points at the same primitive in each mode, so the fade blends without a tint.
TextInput/surface-hover at 0% opacity: the transparent end of the scroll fade on that surface. Points at the same primitive in each mode, so the fade blends without a tint.
Letter spacing for every text style (0). The only step for now; add tighter or wider steps here if a style ever needs them.
Press feedback on buttons and other pressable elements. 160ms.
Modals. 250ms. UI motion stays at or under this unless it uses xl or 2xl.
Default curve. Anything entering or exiting. cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1).
Elements moving or morphing while on screen. cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1).
Sidebar and sheet slides, paired with duration/2xl. cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1).
Reserved for Toast enter and exit. 400ms. Deliberately above the 250ms UI limit.
Reserved for Sidebar and sheet slides, paired with easing/drawer. 500ms. Deliberately above the 250ms UI limit.
Hover and color changes. Same as the CSS ease keyword: cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1).
Constant motion only: progress fills and hold-to-confirm. Never for entering or exiting UI. linear.
Large phones in landscape and small tablets. min-width 640. Bland has no template at this width.
Tablet layout starts. min-width 768. Matches the tablet 768 x 1024 template.
Large tablets and small laptops. min-width 1024. Matches the tablet 1024 x 1366 template.
Desktop layout starts. min-width 1280. Matches the desktop 1280 x 832 template.
Wide desktop. min-width 1536. Matches the desktop 1536 x 864 template.
One full turn of a loading spinner, repeated while loading. 800ms, paired with easing/linear. Continuous motion only, not for entering or exiting UI.

How long a Toast stays on screen before it dismisses itself (5s). Not an animation: the Toaster in code reads it, and pauses it while the pointer is over the stack, focus is inside it or the page is hidden. Its exit then runs at duration/xl.
